name: GATE Overflow Test Series 2024 | Calculus | Test 1

question.text:
If $f(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}
\frac{\sin[x]}{[x]} & \text{ when } \ [x] \neq 0 \\
0 & \text{ when } \ [x] = 0
\end{array}\right., $ where [.] denotes the greatest integer function, then $\displaystyle \lim_{x \to 0}f(x)$ is equal to

  1. $1$
  2. $0$
  3. $-1$
  4. none of the above

Let $f(x)$ be the function defined as $$f(x)= \left\{
\begin{array}{ll}
\frac{k\cos x}{2x-\pi} & \text{ when } \ x \neq \frac{\pi}{2} \\
3 & \text { when } \ x = \frac{\pi}{2}
\end{array}
\right. $$
If $\displaystyle \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{2}}f(x) = f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right),$ the value of $k$ is

  1. $6$
  2. $-6$
  3. $8$
  4. $-8$

While minimizing a continuous function $f(x),$ necessary and sufficient conditions for a point $x_0$ to be a minima are

  1. $f'(x_0) > 0\text{ and } f’’(x_0) = 0$
  2. $f'(x_0) < 0 \text{ and } f’’(x_0) = 0$
  3. $f'(x_0) = 0 \text{ and } f’’(x_0) < 0$
  4. $f'(x_0) = 0 \text{ and } f’’(x_0) > 0$

The minimum value of the function $$f(x) = \frac{x^3}{3} - x$$ occurs at
  1. $x = 1$
  2. $x =-1$
  3. $x = 0$
  4. $ x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$

If $f(x) = x^{100} + x^{99}+ \dots + x + 1$ then $f'(1)$ is equal to

  1. $5050$
  2. $5049$
  3. $5051$
  4. none of the above

$\displaystyle \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{| x |}{x}$ is equals to
  1. $1$
  2. $-1$
  3. $0$
  4. limit does not exist

Find the 'c' of Rolle's mean value theorem for $f(x) = x^3 - 4x \in [-2,2].$
  1. $\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}$
  2. $-\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}$
  3. $\pm \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}$
  4. None of the above

Which of the following function is strictly decreasing?
  1. $f(x) = ax+b$ for $x \in \mathbb{R}, a,b > 0$
  2. $f(x) = e^{2x}$ for $x \in \mathbb{R}$
  3. $f(x) = \frac{2}{x} + 5$ for $x \in \mathbb{R}$
  4. $f(x) = x^3 -6x^2+15x-18$ for $x \in \mathbb{R}$

$\displaystyle \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x(1+ \cos x)}$ is equals to
  1. $0$
  2. $\frac{1}{2}$
  3. $1$
  4. $-1$

Compute the value of $$\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\tan^7 x}{\cot^7x + \tan^7x}dx$$
  1. $\pi$
  2. $\frac{\pi}{4}$
  3. $1$
  4. $\frac{\pi}{2}$

If $f(x) = \dfrac{1}{4x^2+2x+1}$ then its maximum value is

  1. $0.75$
  2. $1.33$
  3. $0.25$
  4. It does not have a maximum value

The value of $$\lim_{x \to 0} x\sin{\frac{1}{x}}$$
  1. $1$
  2. $0$
  3. $\frac{1}{2}$
  4. Does not exist
If $\displaystyle \lim_{x \to 0}\sin{(mx)}\cot{\left (\frac{x}{\sqrt 3}\right)} = 2$ then $m = $ _________ (rounded off up to $2$ decimal places)

Let $f(x)$ be the function defined as $$f(x)= \left\{
\begin{array}{ll}
\mid x\mid  & \text{for } 0 < x \leq 2 \\
1 & \text{for } x= 0
\end{array}
\right. $$
At $x = 0, f$ has:

  1. has local maximum
  2. has local minimum
  3. no local maximum
  4. no extremum

The value of $\displaystyle \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin{(2+x)} - \sin{(2-x)}}{x}$ is

  1. $2\cos2$
  2. $1$
  3. $2\sin 2$
  4. does not exist

The value of $\displaystyle \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sqrt{2+x} - \sqrt{2}}{x}.$
  1. $\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$
  2. $\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}$
  3. $0$
  4. Limit does not exist

If $f(x) = \left \{ \begin{array}{ll}
x^2 - 1; & 0< x < 2 \\
2x+3;& 2 \le x < 3
\end{array} \right.,$ the quadratic equation whose roots are $\displaystyle \lim_{x \to 2^-}f(x)$ and $\displaystyle \lim_{x \to 2^+}f(x)$ is

  1. $x^2-6x+9 = 0$
  2. $x^2-7x+8 = 0$
  3. $x^2-14x+49 = 0$
  4. $x^2-10x+21 = 0$

The value of limit $$\lim_{x\to \frac{\pi}{6}} \frac{2\sin^2{x} + \sin{x} - 1}{2\sin^2{x} - 3\sin{x} + 1}$$
  1. $3$
  2. $-3$
  3. $1$
  4. limit does not exist

For which value of $'c'$ Lagrange's mean value theorem is applicable for the function $f(x) = \log x$ in $[1,e].$
  1. $1$
  2. $e$
  3. $\frac{1}{e-1}$
  4. $e-1$
The maximum value of $f(x) = 2x^3 -9x^2 +12x -3$ in the interval $0 \leq x \leq 3$ is _________

The value of the integral $$I =\int_{-\infty }^{\infty}\frac{dx}{1+x^2}$$
  1. $-\pi$
  2. $-\frac{\pi}{2}$
  3. $\frac{\pi}{2}$
  4. $\pi$

Let $f$ be the function defined as$$ f(x)=\left \{ \begin{array}{ll}
x + 2 & \text{when } x \le -1 \\
cx^2 & \text{when } x > -1
\end{array} \right.$$ Which of the following is the correct value of $'c'$ if $\displaystyle \lim_{x \to -1}f(x)$ exists?

  1. $1$
  2. $-1$
  3. $0$
  4. none of the above

The maximum value of the real valued function $\sin x + \cos x$ is

  1. $2$
  2. $1$
  3. $0$
  4. $\sqrt{2}$
The value of the integral $$I =\int_{-1}^{2}\left(1 + \mid x \mid \right)dx$$ $=$ _________ (rounded up to $1$ decimal place)

Which of the following function(s) is/are continuous at $x = 3?$ (Mark all the appropriate choices)

  1. $f(x) = \left\{\begin{matrix}
    2; & \text{when } x = 3 \\
    x-1; & \text{when } \ x > 3 \\
    \frac{x+3}{3}; &\text{when } x<3
    \end{matrix} \right.$

  2. $f(x) = \left\{
    \begin{matrix}
    4; & \text{when } x = 3 \\
    8-x;& \text{when } x \neq 3
    \end{matrix}\right. $
  3. $f(x) = \left\{
    \begin{matrix}
    x+3; & \text{when } x \leq 3\\
    x-4; & \text{when } x > 3
    \end{matrix} \right.$
  4. $f(x) = \left\{
    \begin{matrix}
    \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^3- 27}}; & \text{when } x<3
    \end{matrix} \right.$

Consider the following definite integral $$I =\int_{0}^{1}\frac{(\sin^{-1} x)^2}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$$ The value of the integral is
  1. $\frac{\pi^3}{24}$
  2. $\frac{\pi^3}{12}$
  3. $\frac{\pi^3}{48}$
  4. $\frac{\pi^3}{64}$

For which positive integer $n$ is $$ \lim_{x\to3} \frac{x^n - 3^n}{x-3} = 108?$$
  1. $3$
  2. $4$
  3. $5$
  4. $6$
The minimum value of the function $f(x) = \frac{1}{3}x(x^2-3)$ in the interval $-100 \leq \ x \leq 100$ occurs at $x = $_________

What is the value of the integration $$I =\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\log(\sin x)\;dx$$

  1. 0
  2. $\frac{-\pi}{2}\log 2$
  3. $-\pi \log 2$
  4. $\log 2$

Let $f:\mathbf{R}\to \mathbf{R}$ be defined by $f(x) = 2x+\cos x.\; f:$

  1. has a minimum at $x =\pi$
  2. has a maximum at $x = 0$
  3. is a decreasing function
  4. is an increasing function
